issues.description: The UML in the problem statement and the solution implementation define Farm.singFarmSongVerse to accept an Animal parameter (singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)), but the template's Farm.java declares singFarmSongVerse without an Animal parameter (the parameter is commented out). This discrepancy can confuse students about the intended method signature and prevents straightforward implementation of singFarmSong() that delegates to singFarmSongVerse for each animal.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Farm.java method signature to accept an Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and either provide a minimal implementation or leave a clear TODO body. This aligns the template with the UML in problem_statement.md and the solution, removing ambiguity so students can implement singFarmSong() by iterating over animals and calling singFarmSongVerse(animal).
